'''Fyiona''', nicknamed '''Lawless Fyiona''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. During the [[third Galactic War]] she was stationed at the [[Joint Operations Base]] arrival platform of the [[Invasion Zone]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where she provided training to other smugglers.<ref name="Legacy" />
